entities.name: tax inspector
entities.what: Outside the tax office, in a long robe, receiving the manifest from a carter (余辉: the inspector naming a large figure; museum: owner and official arguing). Faces right toward the carters, slightly toward the viewer.

entities.name: tax official
entities.what: Seated behind the desk in the three-bay tax office, about to write the declaration; faces the street. Feet hidden under the desk, so the foot point is estimated.

entities.name: camel driver
entities.what: Driver of the camel caravan's tail inside the gate, holding the lead rope; faces right toward the camels, which are walking out through the gate.

entities.name: tower watchman
entities.what: The lone figure in the tower's doorway. 余辉 and the museum: a watchman looking down at the tax-office quarrel; Hansen: a sightseer gazing into the city. Either way he looks toward the city side. Lower body hidden by the threshold; the 10 m floor height is assumed, not measured. Painted at about half the size of the street figures.

entities.name: bridge porter
entities.what: Porter with two baskets on a shoulder pole, walking across the moat bridge toward the gate (into the city).

entities.name: bridge sightseer
entities.what: Sightseer in a blue robe leaning on the near railing with folded arms, watching the water (邵琦: people at the railing watching fish); head turned right. Legs hidden behind the railing, so the foot point is estimated.

entities.name: tax carter manifest
entities.what: The carter in the brown robe at the bales, handing the manifest to the inspector (余辉: the second carter hands him the manifest and a brush). Back half-turned to the viewer.

entities.name: tax declarer
entities.what: Inside the tax office, leaning over the desk toward the official to declare the goods (余辉: one carter goes inside to declare). Feet hidden by the desk; foot point estimated.

entities.name: wall recliner
entities.what: Outside the gate, a man in white half-reclining against the foot of the wall, dozing (邵琦: 城墙下有人靠着城墙休息).

entities.name: wall idler white
entities.what: Idler in a white jacket and trousers, standing in the group by the wall, hands in sleeves, talking.

entities.name: wall idler blue
entities.what: Man in a knee-length blue robe and white trousers at the front of the group, looking out toward the road.

entities.name: wall idler grey
entities.what: Man in grey behind the group, turned toward the others.

entities.name: wall idler stick
entities.what: Man in white at the wall end of the group, holding a stick.

entities.name: wall squatter
entities.what: Man in brown squatting at the right of the group.

entities.name: rail watcher 2
entities.what: Man in white leaning on the near railing of the moat bridge with folded arms, watching the water (邵琦: 观鱼). Legs hidden behind the railing; foot point estimated like bridge_sightseer's.

entities.name: rail watcher 3
entities.what: Man in a blue robe leaning on the near railing, chin on his hands.

entities.name: rail watcher 4
entities.what: Man in white leaning on the near railing beside the man in blue.
